program.name: Five-Split 60 II
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: Five-Split 60, one level harder: every day starts where the original's Level II did, with the newer moves in the mix.
program.about: A classic body-part split where each muscle group gets its own day. Chest, back, legs, shoulders and arms, then abs and cardio, in straight sets with abs to close. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up. This II is the same program one level up, with the newest moves in the mix, and its Level III adds a set where the day has room.
program.split: Chest / back / legs / shoulders & arms / abs & cardio
